style: Read this in a clear, upbeat, professional product-demo voice, at a steady pace:

lines.text: Meet kAIzen. We built Kaizen Agent to stop silent scrap, before it costs hours of production.
Kaizen Agent spots the defect on the product, traces it to the cause, guides the repair in the technician's language, and closes only when fifty good parts prove the fix.
Here is the system, live on Google Cloud. Gemma 3 inspects every part at the edge, and events flow through Pub/Sub to a Google ADK orchestrator.
It runs seven Gemini agents, backed by BigQuery, Vertex AI Search and Firestore. Let's follow one real incident.
On our simulated factory line, we trigger a worn tool on machine CNC-02. The Gemma 3 edge filter flags the scratched parts, and drops normal frames on-premise.
Only the defect events are published to Pub/Sub.
Seconds later, the Plant Ops dashboard raises one clear alert: an eight percent defect rate, against a three percent control limit.
The Traceability agent queries part genealogy in BigQuery, and isolates machine CNC-02 and tool T07.
The Root Cause agent searches the manuals and past 8D reports with Vertex AI Search. Gemini concludes a chipped edge on tool T07, ninety-five percent confident.
The technician gets the job on their phone, with the root cause, and a work order drafted by the Incident Scribe.
In guided repair, the Copilot runs on Gemini. Asked what is wrong, it explains the defect from the incident context.
The technician shows the removed insert, and Gemini sees the chipped, worn corner in the photo.
Tap the manual icon, and each step card shows exactly what to do, cited to the CNC-02 manual, page and section.
When all five steps are done, the technician submits the repair.
Now the product has to prove the fix. The incident closes only after fifty good parts in a row.
The 8D report is already drafted. The shift leader reviews it, and approves the release of the line.
Approval closes the loop. The 8D, work order and SOP proposal are saved to Cloud Storage, and the fix is indexed into Vertex AI Search.
The Knowledge Base now lists this incident, and anyone can ask how a past problem was fixed.
SOP changes are queued for review, so the next shift starts from a better procedure.
Kaizen Agent. The product tells the truth. AI traces it back. Built on Google Cloud.
